018package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.master.assignment;
019
020import java.util.ArrayList;
021import java.util.List;
022import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentSkipListMap;
023import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.TableName;
024import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.RegionInfo;
025import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.TableState;
026import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.master.RegionState;
027import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.master.TableStateManager;
028import org.apache.yetus.audience.InterfaceAudience;
029import org.slf4j.Logger;
030import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
031
032/**
033 * Tracks regions that are currently in transition (RIT) - those not yet in their terminal state.
034 */
035@InterfaceAudience.Private
036public class RegionInTransitionTracker {
037  private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RegionInTransitionTracker.class);
038
039  private final List<RegionState.State> DISABLE_TABLE_REGION_STATE =
040    List.of(RegionState.State.OFFLINE, RegionState.State.CLOSED);
041
042  private final List<RegionState.State> ENABLE_TABLE_REGION_STATE = List.of(RegionState.State.OPEN);
043
044  // DO NOT USE containsKey()/remove() on regionInTransition with a different RegionInfo instance:
045  // this map is ordered by RegionInfo.COMPARATOR, and that comparator includes the offline flag.
046  // Lookups can therefore fail if the RegionInfo used as the key has a different offline value,
047  // even when it refers to the same region. Offline value changes with splitting.
048  private final ConcurrentSkipListMap<RegionInfo, RegionStateNode> regionInTransition =
049    new ConcurrentSkipListMap<>(RegionInfo.COMPARATOR);
050
051  private TableStateManager tableStateManager;
052
053  /**
054   * Handles a region whose hosting RegionServer has crashed. When a RegionServer fails, all regions
055   * it was hosting are automatically added to the RIT list since they need to be reassigned to
056   * other servers.
057   */
058  public void regionCrashed(RegionStateNode regionStateNode) {
059    if (isReplica(regionStateNode)) {
060      return;
061    }
062
063    if (addRegionInTransition(regionStateNode)) {
064      LOG.debug("{} added to RIT list because hosting region server is crashed ",
065        regionStateNode.getRegionInfo().getEncodedName());
066    }
067  }
068
069  /**
070   * Processes a region state change and updates the RIT tracking accordingly. This is the core
071   * method that determines whether a region should be added to or removed from the RIT list based
072   * on its current state and the table's enabled/disabled status. This method should be called
073   * whenever a region state changes get stored to hbase:meta Note: Only default replicas (replica
074   * ID 0) are tracked. Read replicas are ignored.
075   * @param regionStateNode the region state node with the current state information
076   */
077  public void handleRegionStateNodeOperation(RegionStateNode regionStateNode) {
078    // only consider default replica for availability
079    if (isReplica(regionStateNode)) {
080      return;
081    }
082
083    RegionState.State currentState = regionStateNode.getState();
084    boolean tableEnabled = isTableEnabled(regionStateNode.getTable());
085    List<RegionState.State> terminalStates =
086      tableEnabled ? ENABLE_TABLE_REGION_STATE : DISABLE_TABLE_REGION_STATE;
087
088    // if region is merged or split it should not be in RIT list
089    if (AssignmentManagerUtil.isSplitOrMerged(regionStateNode)) {
090      if (removeRegionInTransition(regionStateNode.getRegionInfo())) {
091        LOG.debug("Removed {} from RIT list as it is split or merged",
092          regionStateNode.getRegionInfo().getEncodedName());
093      }
094    } else if (!terminalStates.contains(currentState)) {
095      if (addRegionInTransition(regionStateNode)) {
096        LOG.debug("{} added to RIT list because it is in-between state, region state : {} ",
097          regionStateNode.getRegionInfo().getEncodedName(), currentState);
098      }
099    } else {
100      if (removeRegionInTransition(regionStateNode.getRegionInfo())) {
101        LOG.debug("Removed {} from RIT list as reached to terminal state {}",
102          regionStateNode.getRegionInfo().getEncodedName(), currentState);
103      }
104    }
105  }
106
107  private boolean isTableEnabled(TableName tableName) {
108    if (tableStateManager != null) {
109      return tableStateManager.isTableState(tableName, TableState.State.ENABLED,
110        TableState.State.ENABLING);
111    }
112    // AssignmentManager calls setTableStateManager once hbase:meta is confirmed online, if it is
113    // still null it means confirmation is still pending. One should not access TableStateManger
114    // till the time.
115    assert TableName.isMetaTableName(tableName);
116    return true;
117  }
118
119  /**
120   * Handles the deletion of a region by removing it from RIT tracking. This is called when a region
121   * is permanently removed from the cluster, typically after a successful merge operation where the
122   * parent regions are cleaned up. During table deletion, table should be already disabled and all
123   * the region are already OFFLINE
124   * @param regionInfo the region being deleted
125   */
126  public void handleRegionDelete(RegionInfo regionInfo) {
127    removeRegionInTransition(regionInfo);
128  }
129
130  private boolean addRegionInTransition(final RegionStateNode regionStateNode) {
131    return regionInTransition.putIfAbsent(regionStateNode.getRegionInfo(), regionStateNode) == null;
132  }
133
134  private boolean removeRegionInTransition(final RegionInfo regionInfo) {
135    return regionInTransition.remove(regionInfo) != null;
136  }
137
138  public void stop() {
139    regionInTransition.clear();
140  }
141
142  public boolean hasRegionsInTransition() {
143    return !regionInTransition.isEmpty();
144  }
145
146  public List<RegionStateNode> getRegionsInTransition() {
147    return new ArrayList<>(regionInTransition.values());
148  }
149
150  public void setTableStateManager(TableStateManager tableStateManager) {
151    this.tableStateManager = tableStateManager;
152  }
153
154  private static boolean isReplica(RegionStateNode regionStateNode) {
155    return regionStateNode.getRegionInfo().getReplicaId() != RegionInfo.DEFAULT_REPLICA_ID;
156  }
157
158}
